title: fix(core): resolve {next_week_end} and {next_year_end} in the client date-macro resolver
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgNTEGwukC81vXo95pnRQCnF)_
Fixes #30134

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Clause-②: no — the client resolver catches up with tokens the spec already declares
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台的日期占位符解析器补上 `{next_week_end}`（下周日）与 `{next_year_end}`（明年 12 月 31 日），并加一条测试逐个核对 spec 声明的全部固定占位符都能在客户端解析。
- 为什么改：spec 早已声明这两个占位符，服务端也能解析，但控制台原样显示 `{next_week_end}` 文本，比较区间与趋势标签随之出错。
- 风险与回滚：只新增两个映射，既有占位符不变；回滚即撤销本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts`（两行新映射）、`date-macros.specTokens-30134.test.ts`（防漂移钉）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/date-macros.specTokens-30134.test.ts`，预期 38 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `resolveDateMacros` (`@object-ui/core`) resolves `{next_week_end}` as the Sunday of next week (Monday-start weeks, the same week `{next_week_start}` opens, per the spec's `DATE_MACRO_DESCRIPTIONS` entry "Sunday of next week") and `{next_year_end}` as Dec 31 of next year ("Dec 31 of next year").
- The resolver's header list now names both, and its "keep in sync" note points at the new pin instead of promising a future de-duplication.
- New `date-macros.specTokens-30134.test.ts`: iterates the spec's exported `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, not copied) and fails on any token the client leaves unresolved; pins `next_week_end` from a Monday, a Sunday and across the 2026→2027 year boundary (Wed 2026-12-30 → `2027-01-04`..`2027-01-10`), and `next_year_end` on Dec 31 and Jan 1.
- No new dependency: `@object-ui/core` already depends on `@objectstack/spec` at runtime.
- Changeset `@object-ui/core: patch`.

## Tests

<details><summary>Changed tests plus every test file importing the changed module or its importers (head 8dec3da3, re-run after the main merge)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the 5 `date-macros` / `dashboard-filters` / `filter-tokens` test files: Test Files 5 passed, Tests 114 passed.
- The 13 test files importing `compare-to` / `dashboard-filters` / `filter-tokens`: Test Files 13 passed, Tests 250 passed.
- After merging `origin/main`: the two `date-macros` files, Tests 46 passed.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/core --concurrency=2` (runs `tsconfig.test.json` too): 4 tasks successful.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `next_week_end` entry, source import, no dist on the path): the new file went red, 2 failed (`{next_week_end} resolves to a day or an instant`, `{next_week_end} is the Sunday of next week`); `git diff HEAD` empty after the restore leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's observation on `ui/packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` (`FilterBuilderDateRangePreset`) is not changed here. The union is a deliberately separate vocabulary (renamed from `DateRangePreset` in objectui#4167 because it adds future windows the dashboard schema refuses), so deriving it from `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` would drop `tomorrow`, `next_week`, `next_year`, `next_7_days` and `next_90_days` that its filter-builder surface uses. Its doc comment's counts ("thirteen", "eight") no longer match the spec table, which now holds sixteen. Reported to the seat; not filed.

</details>
